# Copilot instructions

The instructions for this repository live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root, shared by
every agent. This file is a pointer and holds no content of its own.

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before proposing changes, then, for the surface you are about to
touch, the file its [Doctrine by surface](../AGENTS.md#doctrine-by-surface) table names. Those files
live in `.claude/rules/`, which only Claude Code loads by itself.
